description: Celestia DA light-node scaffold — docker-compose for the node, config.toml overrides, submit-blob.sh CLI, and a stdlib Go client that round-trips a blob via JSON-RPC.

buildHints.whenToUse: Any project that needs a Celestia data-availability layer: modular rollups, sovereign chains, or off-chain data-posting pipelines that must prove DA on the Celestia mocha testnet.
firstSteps: Start the light node: `docker compose up -d` — allow 1-2 minutes for initial header sync.
Fund the node wallet from the Mocha faucet (address in node logs) — blob.Submit costs TIA gas; without funds you will see `insufficient funds`.
Export the auth token: `export CELESTIA_NODE_AUTH_TOKEN=$(docker compose exec node celestia light auth admin --p2p.network mocha-4)`
Run the Go round-trip client: `go run ./cmd/celestia-node` — submits a blob and retrieves it at the returned height.
Or use the shell script: `bash submit-blob.sh "my payload"`
gotchas: CELESTIA_NODE_AUTH_TOKEN is per container instance — re-export after any `docker compose down && up` cycle.
blob.GetAll returns null until the chain head advances past the inclusion height — poll `header.NetworkHead` if GetAll returns empty.
Namespaces must be exactly 29 bytes: 1 version byte + 28 ID bytes. Version-0 user namespaces require the first 18 ID bytes to be 0x00.
The Go client uses only stdlib — go.sum is intentionally empty. Do not add external deps without running `go mod tidy`.
Build the binary with `go build ./cmd/celestia-node` from the project root; the resulting binary is named `celestia-node`.
architectureNotes: cmd/celestia-node/main.go uses only the Go standard library; go.mod declares the module but has no require entries, and go.sum is empty.
All RPC calls target 127.0.0.1:26658 via JSON-RPC 2.0 with Bearer token auth — same endpoint for blob.Submit, blob.GetAll, and header queries.
config.toml is the committed knob reference; copy to data/config.toml inside the Docker volume to apply custom overrides.

placeholders.description: Hardcoded namespace constant and sample payload. Replace the `namespace` constant and `payload` variable in main() with your application's namespace and data.
Uses the same hardcoded NAMESPACE as cmd/celestia-node/main.go. Update NAMESPACE in both files together.
